name: Temporal Point Cloud Initialization via Chamfer Distance Minimization
definition: A technique to reduce training time for dynamic video scenes by initializing the point cloud of the current frame using the learned model from the previous frame, leveraging temporal correlation between nearby frames.
summary: Temporal Point Cloud Initialization via Chamfer Distance Minimization accelerates dynamic scene training by aligning consecutive frames' point clouds through Chamfer distance minimization before refining radiance parameters.
